home.aboutBody: This service lets you look up PIDs and see information about the resources they identify.
home.docsHint: Read the documentation and learn more about the PID Resolver.

resolve.hint: Enter just a Namespace ID or a Namespace ID and a PID separated by a slash, then press Enter or choose Show Details.
resolve.scopedPidHelp: Enter a PID from this Namespace, then press Enter or choose Show Details. Use Open URL to open the web address linked to the PID.

help.namespace: A collection of PIDs that share the same format and settings.
help.namespaceId: A unique ID for this Namespace. Use it when looking up the Namespace or a PID under it.
help.mount: The public web address used to open this Namespace.
help.pidFormat: How PIDs in this Namespace are built: a pattern (stars become random characters) and which character set is used. See the API specification for more detail.
help.tags: Labels attached for grouping or finding items.
help.createdNamespace: When this Namespace was first created.
help.createdPid: When this PID was first created.
help.updatedNamespace: When this Namespace itself was last changed (not its PIDs).
help.updatedPid: When this PID was last changed.
help.pid: A persistent identifier that uniquely identifies this resource within its Namespace.
help.url: The web address this PID points to, if one is set.

serviceUnavailable.title: Service unavailable
serviceUnavailable.message: The service could not be reached.

serviceError.title: Service error
serviceError.message: Something went wrong while contacting the service.

serviceNotAvailable.title: Service unavailable
serviceNotAvailable.message: This service is not available right now.

pidHasNoUrl.title: URL not found
pidHasNoUrl.message: This PID does not have a URL associated with it.

pageNotFound.title: Not found
pageNotFound.message: The requested page or resource was not found.
